enonce_complet: ## Best practices {% id="best-practices" %} * Keep each question focused on a single decision or rubric. Complex rubrics work in one question when criteria are explicit, or you can split independent checks into separate questions in one request and combine the answers in code. * Write the full question in the instructions. The model never sees question keys or your variable names. * Give each choice option and score level a short description. Make adjacent score levels clearly distinct, and keep score scales linear. Because score averages array indices (0, 1, 2, and up), exponential scales like 1, 10, 100, and 1000 skew the expected value. * Plan for inputs that fit no choice option. Check confidence before acting on the top option, or pair the choice question with a yes/no scope check such as "Is this message about an order?". If you add a catch-all option, use a non-positional key like "other" rather than "none_of_the_above", since the API sorts option keys alphabetically. * Prefer positive phrasing. Ask "Is the tier Gold?" and subtract the yes probability from 1 in code rather than asking negated questions such as "Is the tier NOT Gold?". * Send only the fields the questions need. Unrelated content lowers accuracy. * Compare numbers, dates, and durations in code, then pass the result or a named bucket in the input. * Treat input as untrusted. User-supplied text can argue for its own classification. Write explicit criteria, test with adversarial examples, and keep a human or a second check on high-stakes actions such as payouts.

titre: google-decisions-guide-v1 — Decisions API or structured output {% id="when-to-use" %}
enonce_complet: ## Decisions API or structured output {% id="when-to-use" %} Use the Decisions API when you need calibrated probabilities over closed-ended outcomes: * Route a request to a model, queue, agent, or tool. * Check inputs and outputs against many policy rules at once. * Decide which tools an agent needs, or whether to compact, escalate, or stop. * Filter, score, or rank candidate results against a rubric. * React to UI state, audio, or video frames in real time. | Use the Decisions API when you need | Use the [Interactions API](/docs/interactions-overview) when you need | | :--- | :--- | | A yes/no probability, one option from a fixed set, or a rating on a fixed scale | Generated text, summaries, or explanations | | Calibrated probabilities you can threshold | Extracted values or objects that follow your own JSON schema (see [Structured outputs](/docs/structured-output)) | | Many independent checks over the same input in one call | Tool calls with arguments | | Low latency and zero output token cost | Multi-step reasoning |

titre: google-decisions-guide-v1 — Request and response reference {% id="request" %}
enonce_complet: ## Request and response reference {% id="request" %} | Field | Type | Required | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `model` | string | yes | Model ID: `gemini-decision-1`. See [Gemini Decision 1](/docs/models/gemini-decision-1). | | `input` | string, `Content`, or `Content[]` | yes | Shared context for all questions (text, image, audio, video, or PDF document). See [Input](/docs/decisions-api#input). | | `questions` | map of string to `Question` | yes | 1 to 1,000 questions. You choose the keys (`[A-Za-z0-9_-]+`, up to 64 characters). Answers come back under the same keys. | Every question has: | Field | Type | Required | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `type` | `noul`, `choice`, or `score` | yes | Question type. | | `instructions` | string, `TextContent`, or `TextContent[]` | yes | The question to evaluate against the input. Text only. | | `criteria` | depends on type | choice and score: yes. noul: no. | The possible answers. See [Question types](/docs/decisions-api#question-types). | The API evaluates each question independently against the shared input. Questions can't see each other, and adding or removing one doesn't change the other answers. The model never sees question keys, so write the full question in the instructions field. The response contains: | Field | Type | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `answers` | map of string to `Answer` | One answer per question, under the same keys as `questions`. Each answer has a type that matches its question. | | `usage` | `Usage` | Input token counts by modality (text, image, and audio, with video frames and PDF page images counted as image tokens) and 0 output tokens. Only input tokens are billed; see [Pricing](/docs/pricing#gemini-decision). | When input safety filters block a request, the API returns an HTTP `400 Bad Request` error instead of `answers`. The JSON `error` object includes a `message` and a `code` (`safety`, `prohibited_content`, `blocklist`, `image_safety`, or `content_blocked`): ```json { "error": { "code": "safety", "message": "Request blocked due to safety violations (harmful content). Please modify your input and retry." } } ```

## Limits {% id="limits" %} | Limit | Value | | :--- | :--- | | Questions per request | 1 to 1,000 (bounded by the 262,144-token context window) | | Options per choice question | 2 to 255 | | Levels per score question | 2 to 255 non-empty strings (2 to 10 recommended for most rubrics) | | Question key | 1 to 64 ASCII characters matching `[A-Za-z0-9_-]+` | | Option key | 1 to 128 characters (up to 512 UTF-8 bytes). Internal ASCII spaces are allowed. Leading or trailing spaces, control characters, and non-ASCII spaces aren't allowed. | | Context window | 262,144 tokens across shared input and all questions | | JSON nesting depth | 100 levels | | Media per request | Same as the [Interactions API](/docs/interactions-overview) | | Question instructions | Text only | When a request exceeds a limit or fails key validation, the API returns HTTP 400 with an error message that names the rule you exceeded.

## Limitations {% id="limitations" %} * Available on the Gemini Developer API (v1beta) with [Gemini Decision 1](/docs/models/gemini-decision-1) only. * Question instructions accept text only. Media inside questions isn't supported. * The Decisions API doesn't support YouTube URLs or direct Cloud Storage (`gs://`) URIs. Pass media using a [Files API](/docs/files) URI, a public or signed HTTPS URL, or inline base64 bytes. * Conversation history, thought, and tool-call blocks aren't supported as input blocks. Serialize multi-turn context as text. * The Decisions API doesn't support context caching, [Batch API](/docs/batch-api), or Flex or Priority inference. Repeated input across requests counts in full.

## What's next {% id="whats-next" %} * Test yes/no, choice, and score questions interactively on custom text and media in the [Decisions Playground](https://aistudio.google.com/apps/f6cbef57-8bad-443a-813f-4d4c8f9750af?fullscreenApplet=true), then export runnable code. * Explore sample apps built with Gemini Decision 1 in Google AI Studio, including [Doorstep Parcels](https://aistudio.google.com/apps/bdca3fee-8d0a-4663-b30e-73828a55c1e8?fullscreenApplet=true) and [Find the Zookeeper](https://aistudio.google.com/apps/b86d2f3b-c1d4-4d44-9198-5303a0cb65c1?fullscreenApplet=true). * Review model specifications on the [Gemini Decision 1](/docs/models/gemini-decision-1) model page, along with [Pricing](/docs/pricing#gemini-decision) and [Rate limits](/docs/rate-limits#gemini-decision). * Build autonomous workflows with [Managed agents](/docs/agents) on the Gemini API.

titre: google-decisions-modele-v1 — En-tête et synthèse (> ## AI Agent Context)
enonce_complet: > ## AI Agent Context > - Full documentation index: https://aistudio.google.com/llms.txt > - Gemini Docs MCP server (consistent live info): https://gemini-api-docs-mcp.dev > - Coding agent skills & setup guide: https://aistudio.google.com/docs/coding-agents.md # Gemini Decision 1 Gemini Decision 1 is a specialized multimodal model built for the [Decisions API](/docs/decisions-api). It evaluates typed questions over text, images, video, audio, and PDFs in a single prefill pass and returns calibrated outcome probabilities with zero output tokens. Use Gemini Decision 1 for request routing, policy checks across many rules at once, candidate scoring against a rubric, tool selection, and low-latency classification over live media streams. A single request can evaluate up to 1,000 independent questions over shared input up to 262,144 tokens: * **Yes/no:** Returns a calibrated probability from 0.01 to 0.99 and a confidence score. * **Single-select:** Evaluates 2 to 255 options and returns the top option, per-option probabilities, and confidence. * **Rubric rating:** Evaluates 2 to 255 ordered rubric levels and returns the probability-weighted expected score, per-level probabilities, and confidence. {% button href="/docs/decisions-api" variant="primary" %}View documentation{% /button %}

## Quickstart {% id="quickstart" %} Evaluate a yes/no question and a routing choice over the same customer message in one call: {% tabs %} {% tab filename="decisions.py" label="Python" %} ```python from google import genai client = genai.Client(http_options={"api_version": "v1beta"}) result = client.decisions.create( model="gemini-decision-1", input="The blue mug I ordered on Monday arrived cracked on Wednesday.", questions={ "is_damaged": { "type": "noul", "instructions": "Did the item arrive damaged?", }, "queue": { "type": "choice", "instructions": "Which support queue should handle this message?", "criteria": { "billing": "Payment, invoice, or refund questions.", "replacements": "Damaged, missing, or wrong items.", "general": "Product questions and account updates.", }, }, }, ) damaged = result.answers["is_damaged"] queue = result.answers["queue"] print(f"P(damaged)={damaged.noul:.2f} queue={queue.choice}") ``` {% /tab %} {% tab filename="decisions.mjs" label="JavaScript" %} ```javascript import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai"; const ai = new GoogleGenAI({ apiVersion: "v1beta" }); const result = await ai.decisions.create({ model: "gemini-decision-1", input: "The blue mug I ordered on Monday arrived cracked on Wednesday.", questions: { is_damaged: { type: "noul", instructions: "Did the item arrive damaged?", }, queue: { type: "choice", instructions: "Which support queue should handle this message?", criteria: { billing: "Payment, invoice, or refund questions.", replacements: "Damaged, missing, or wrong items.", general: "Product questions and account updates.", }, }, }, }); const damaged = result.answers?.is_damaged; const queue = result.answers?.queue; if (damaged?.type === "noul" && queue?.type === "choice") { console.log(`P(damaged)=${damaged.noul} queue=${queue.choice}`); } ``` {% /tab %} {% tab filename="decisions.sh" label="REST" %} ```bash curl -X POST "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/decisions" \ -H "x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "model": "gemini-decision-1", "input": "The blue mug I ordered on Monday arrived cracked on Wednesday.", "questions": { "is_damaged": { "type": "noul", "instructions": "Did the item arrive damaged?" }, "queue": { "type": "choice", "instructions": "Which support queue should handle this message?", "criteria": { "billing": "Payment, invoice, or refund questions.", "replacements": "Damaged, missing, or wrong items.", "general": "Product questions and account updates." } } } }' ``` {% /tab %} {% /tabs %}

## Documentation {% id="documentation" %} Visit the [Decisions API](/docs/decisions-api) guide for request schemas, criteria design, multimodal inputs, and calibration details. See [Pricing](/docs/pricing#gemini-decision) and [Rate limits](/docs/rate-limits#gemini-decision) for billing and quota tiers.

## Sample apps {% id="sample-apps" %} Explore interactive sample apps in Google AI Studio built with Gemini Decision 1: * [Decisions Playground](https://aistudio.google.com/apps/f6cbef57-8bad-443a-813f-4d4c8f9750af?fullscreenApplet=true): Test yes/no, choice, and score questions interactively on custom text and media inputs. * [Doorstep Parcels](https://aistudio.google.com/apps/bdca3fee-8d0a-4663-b30e-73828a55c1e8?fullscreenApplet=true): Classify delivery photos for package condition and placement using calibrated probabilities. * [Find the Zookeeper](https://aistudio.google.com/apps/b86d2f3b-c1d4-4d44-9198-5303a0cb65c1?fullscreenApplet=true): Evaluate visual attributes across scene candidates in a single pass.

titre: google-decisions-reference-v1 — En-tête et synthèse (> ## AI Agent Context)
enonce_complet: > ## AI Agent Context > - Full documentation index: https://aistudio.google.com/llms.txt > - Gemini Docs MCP server (consistent live info): https://gemini-api-docs-mcp.dev > - Coding agent skills & setup guide: https://aistudio.google.com/docs/coding-agents.md # Gemini Decisions API {% callout type="note" %} This API is in Beta. Endpoints are under `/v1beta/`. {% /callout %} The Decisions API evaluates a batch of structured decision questions against a shared input in a single request. Each question is one of three types: a binary (true / false) `noul` question, a single-select `choice` question over mutually exclusive options, or a quantitative `score` question over a rubric of discrete levels. The response contains a calibrated answer for each question, keyed by the question IDs from the request, including a confidence score and, for `choice` and `score` questions, the probability of each option or level.

## Methods {% id="methods" %} {% table %} * Method * HTTP request --- * [Creating a decision](/api-reference/decisions/create-decision) * {% mark class="http-post" %}{% icon name="north_east" /%}`POST`{% /mark %} `/v1beta/decisions` Evaluates a batch of structured decision questions against a shared input. {% /table %}
